subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should the completed no-go end this shared route-entry-bundle investigation, or should ClawHub fund a distinct measured optimization hypothesis?
rationale: The requested first A/B was performed and failed its own size gate; choosing whether to invest in a new route-closure strategy is a product and performance-prioritization choice, not a mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Accept the no-go
options.body: Treat the reverted experiment as the final result for this investigation and close it without broad route refactoring.

options.title: Sponsor a new measured target
options.body: Define a separate import boundary, minimum net reduction, and cold-navigation proof requirements before additional work begins.

recommendation.title: Accept the no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the reverted experiment as the final result for this investigation and close it without broad route refactoring.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member author who supplied the measured evidence and recently delivered related performance work.
